page_title: RMA 2-1 BAR | Real Madrid v Barcelona 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is punished with the yellow card.
90+11' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+11' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Ferran Torres (Barcelona) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+11' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+11' Pointless reaction! Andriy Lunin (Real Madrid) receives a red card for unsporting behaviour after the final whistle.
90+11' This is a yellow card! Eder Militao (Real Madrid) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+10' This was really stupid from Pedri (Barcelona)! He is booked for the second time today and is forced to leave the pitch after seeing a red card in the hand of Cesar Soto Grado.
90+9' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+9' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+8' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Wojciech Szczesny to dive and make a save.
90+8' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Pedri (Barcelona). Cesar Soto Grado saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Real Madrid win a free kick.
90+7' Marcus Sorg has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gerard Martin (Barcelona) replacing Alejandro Balde.
90+6' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+5' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Wojciech Szczesny blocks the shot with his legs.
90+4' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 21:14.
90+2' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
90+1' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Kylian Mbappe is replaced by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid).
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jude Bellingham as he is replaced by Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid).
90' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) meets a cross inside the box, but Thibaut Courtois wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
88' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
88' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
86' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
85' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
84' Substitution. Pau Cubarsi makes way for Roony Bardghji (Barcelona).
82' Flag goes up against Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
81' Flag up against Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
81' The resulting corner, taken by Rodrygo (Real Madrid), comes to nothing.
81' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) inside the box. The linesman makes the right call and Real Madrid will have a corner.
80' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
78' Barcelona hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
76' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
75' The attendance for today's match is 78107.
74' It is time for a substitution. Marc Casado (Barcelona) is on for Ferran Torres.
74' Substitution. Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Eric Garcia walks off.
74' Corner kicks – 10:3.
72' Here is a change. Vinicius Junior is going off and Xabi Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
72' Substitution. Federico Valverde walks off the pitch and Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
71' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
71' Corner kick. Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is ready to send the ball into the box.
69' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) has a goal ruled out for offside!
68' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
67' This shall not pass! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
67' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
66' We are about to witness a subsitution. Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) for Arda Guler.
65' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
63' Barcelona keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
60' The percentage of ball possession is – 35:65.

58' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
57' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Cesar Soto Grado and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
55' Barcelona are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.

53' The fans were almost celebrating as Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball was heading towards the middle of the goal, but Thibaut Courtois made an astonishing save!
53' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
52' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner.
52' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the left side of the goal, but it's not enough to beat Wojciech Szczesny who easily stops the effort.
52' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
52' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Real Madrid!

50' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Real Madrid.
49' That looked a certain handball by Eric Garcia (Barcelona) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
48' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
48' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) will deliver the corner kick.

48' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Real Madrid.

47' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Thibaut Courtois was alert and the score remained the same.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' Cesar Soto Grado has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
45+5' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Thibaut Courtois.
45+4' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+2' The statistic for corner kicks – 8:2.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
43' 2 - 1 Goal! Eder Militao passes the ball to the feet of Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 2:1.
42' Pedri (Barcelona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
41' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

41' Pedri (Barcelona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
40' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Wojciech Szczesny has no trouble gathering it.
40' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Madrid.
38' 1 - 1 Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly fires the ball into the middle of the net.
37' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
35' The foul by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) was seen by Cesar Soto Grado who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
35' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Madrid.

34' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Wojciech Szczesny makes a great save to stop his effort.

34' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Thibaut Courtois makes a great save.
32' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

32' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Arda Guler (Real Madrid). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
31' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) works the corner short.
31' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. Real Madrid will take a corner kick.
30' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

30' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) picks up a cross inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the right side of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Wojciech Szczesny, who pulls off a stunning save! The referee signals a corner kick to Real Madrid.
29' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

29' Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a great save to deny Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal. Real Madrid get a corner.
29' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for an infringement.
28' Some patient build-up play from Real Madrid as they look to unlock the defence.
25' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
23' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) for his blatant foul.
22' 1 - 0 Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
20' The ball is cleared after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
18' Thibaut Courtois (Real Madrid) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
16' The possession of the ball – 21:79.
14' Celebrations are cut short for Real Madrid as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
13' The Real Madrid players halt their celebrations as referee Cesar Soto Grado makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

12' What a beautiful moment! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Wojciech Szczesny just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
9' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
7' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
7' Barcelona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
5' The Real Madrid players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Cesar Soto Grado. NO PENALTY!
4' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Real Madrid using VAR. Let's see what happens.

3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Cesar Soto Grado blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Real Madrid are given a penalty!
2' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes the corner kick, but Thibaut Courtois reads it well and stops the effort.
2' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Real Madrid will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Cesar Soto Grado.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
Welcome to our minute-by-minute commentary of today's clash. You can enjoy a written form of everything important that will be happening on the pitch. Have fun.
